_comment: How raw shot records become the six fundamentals. These curves are the aim-training product; changing them changes what the game tells players about themselves, so change them from sim data, never from intuition.

classification._note: Which shots count toward which fundamental. A shot may count toward several.

scoring._model: Each axis maps a raw measurement to 0-100 with score = 100 * exp(-(x / scale)^shape), clamped. Lower raw is better on every axis. `scale` is the value that scores ~37.

leadAndDrop._note: lead and holdover error are combined in quadrature, but reported separately too -- the SIGN of lead error is the diagnosis. Under-leading and mis-aiming are different problems.
leadAndDrop._biasNote: If the mean signed lead error exceeds this and 70% of samples share its sign, the player has a systematic lead bias rather than random spread. That gets its own prescription line.

reactivity.line: You are seeing them late. Targets are on screen {acquire} ms before your first shot -- run Pop-Up until that is under {target} ms.

flicking.line: Your large-angle acquisitions land {error} degrees off. Run Pop-Up and slow down the last third of the flick; you are overshooting, not under-aiming.

targetSwitching.line: You take {gap} s between eliminations. That is enough time for their squad to reset a crossfire on you. Run Switch.

tracking.line: Against crossing targets you are {error} degrees off. Run Strafe at the two shortest distances -- this is a smoothness problem, not a prediction problem.

crosshairPlacement.line: When a target appeared, your crosshair was {offset} degrees away from it. Run Peek. You are winning nothing you have to re-aim for.

leadAndDropUnder.line: You under-lead by {bias} m on average -- you are shooting where they ARE. Run Strafe and consciously aim at empty ground ahead of them.

leadAndDropOver.line: You over-lead by {bias} m on average. You have learned that lead exists and are now overcorrecting. Run Strafe at the two SHORTEST distances to recalibrate.

leadAndDropSpread.line: Your lead error is {error} m but has no consistent direction, so it is drop you are missing, not lead. Run Holdover at 35 and 50 m.

session._maxNote: Hard cap so a grinding session cannot balloon server memory. Aggregates are updated incrementally, so the cap costs detail in the shot list, never accuracy in the scores.
